description: This Java interface defines the contract for SMS campaign write operations within the Fineract platform. It includes methods for creating, updating, deleting, activating, reactivating, and closing SMS campaigns, as well as inserting campaigns into outbound tables and previewing messages.

classes.name: SmsCampaignWritePlatformService
classes.description: An interface defining methods to manage SMS campaigns, including creation, update, deletion, activation, reactivation, and message preview functionalities.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new SMS campaign based on the provided JSON command.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing SMS campaign identified by resourceId with data from the JSON command.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the SMS campaign with the specified resourceId.

methods.name: activateSmsCampaign
methods.description: Activates a specific SMS campaign identified by campaignId, using details from the JSON command.

methods.name: closeSmsCampaign
methods.description: Closes or deactivates an SMS campaign identified by campaignId.

methods.name: reactivateSmsCampaign
methods.description: Reactivates a previously closed or deactivated SMS campaign.

methods.name: insertDirectCampaignIntoSmsOutboundTable
methods.description: Inserts a specified SMS campaign directly into the outbound SMS table, overloaded for different domain objects like Loan, Client, and SavingsAccount.

methods.name: compileSmsTemplate
methods.description: Generates an SMS message by filling in a template with provided parameters.

methods.name: previewMessage
methods.description: Previews the SMS message content based on a JSON query.
